name: searxng
context: You are in the repository of SearXNG, a privacy-respecting metasearch engine (Python, Flask). It has no OpenAPI specification: the search API is documented in `docs/dev/search_api.rst` and the routes are in `searx/webapp.py`. It is running at {targetUrl} (HTML UI at `/`, `/search`, `/preferences`; JSON, CSV and RSS output through `/search?format=json|csv|rss`; metadata at `/healthz`, `/config`, `/opensearch.xml`). The instance has no accounts or login. Its settings enable the html, json, csv and rss formats and exactly one engine, the offline `demo offline` engine (`searx/engines/demo_offline.py`, shortcut `demo`), so no search needs internet access; the demo engine's results are generic key/value items whose caption carries a counter that changes between requests. Autocomplete and the rate limiter are off.

frozen.composeNote: The container searxng-tm-app was created with docker run; compose.yml records the same definition and is not used to start it.
frozen.dataSeed: No accounts and no data: the instance is stateless apart from the per-client preferences cookies. Only the offline `demo offline` engine is enabled (use_default_settings with engines.keep_only: [] plus the demo_offline engine); limiter, image_proxy and autocomplete are off; search formats html, json, csv, rss.
